[body] Serve more users on the same GPUs

novice.takeaway: The presenter wants us to remember that their new method serves more users on existing hardware without changing model outputs, and will be released as open source this quarter.
questions: When exactly will the open-source release happen?
Which GPUs or hardware setups does this apply to?
novice.inferred_claim: The presenter wants us to believe this improvement is efficient, safe, and will soon be publicly available.

peer.takeaway: The presentation's efficiency improvements let more users be served on the same hardware without altering model outputs, and the work will be open-sourced this quarter.
questions: Which open-source project or repo will be released?
What license or platform will host the release?
peer.inferred_claim: The presenter wants the audience to remember these gains are efficiency-only and soon publicly available.

expert.takeaway: This is a summary slide reiterating that the optimizations increase serving capacity without altering model outputs, and the work will be open-sourced this quarter.
questions: Which specific components/code will be open-sourced?
